reference.title: Scenario 2: No title metadata is present
reference.shortdesc: Consider an index .md file in a folder named Kubernetes_user_doc .

section.p: Consider an index .md file in a folder named Kubernetes_user_doc. This file has no title metadata but has an H1 (#). In this case, the converter generates the following DITA bookmap structure:

entry.codeblock: Folder: kubernetes_user_doc Filename: index.md # User Documentation
<map id="kubernetes_user_doc"> <title> User Documentation</title> </map> OR <bookmap id="kubernetes_user_doc"> <booktitle> <mainbooktitle> User Documentation </mainbooktitle> </booktitle> </bookmap>

section.p: Result: The converter falls back to the H1 (#) for the root map title.
